title: MarkdownAgentContractSchemas
description: Input/output contract schema bundle for the Markdown Agent (Stage 5 — Markdown). See /contracts/agents/markdown-agent.md.

input.description: Admits the Markdown Agent only with an approved HumanReviewDecision, its subject Proposal, a valid single-use apply_token, and a resolved template.

proposal_ref.description: Pointer to the sealed Proposal to draft from.

apply_token.description: Single-use token bound to the exact Proposal artifact_id@version.

template_id.description: Identifier of the front-matter/body template to use.
